key_insight: MemoryDojo shows that malicious instructions can persist through agent memory and influence later behavior, with all five evaluated memory systems susceptible.
engineering_relevance: Long-running research and engineering agents need safeguards against poisoned memories, not just malicious inputs in the current session.
method: Trace poisoned information across storage, retrieval, and subsequent agent behavior.
Benchmark five memory systems on multi-session, long-horizon tasks.
Use memory-aware poison optimization to increase attack efficacy.
evidence_signal: The benchmark includes 155 trajectories across four domains, and evaluation finds substantial variation in poisoning effects across memory systems.
watch_item: The abstract does not report numerical attack success rates, limiting quantitative comparison of memory architectures.
paper_title: MemoryDojo: Benchmarking Poisoning Through LLM Agent Memory
